title: Why Do We Get Goosebumps? The Animal Fur Secret!

lines.text: BRRR! A chilly breeze blows into the park, and look at your arms!
lines.caps: *BRRR! A chilly breeze blows, | and look at your *ARMS | right *NOW!

lines.text: Thousands of tiny bumpy dots pop up, making your skin look like a goose!
lines.caps: Thousands of tiny *BUMPS | pop up, making your skin look *JUST | like a *GOOSE!

lines.text: Underneath every single hair on your arm sits a microscopic muscle!
lines.caps: Underneath every *HAIR | on your arm sits a microscopic *MUSCLE | *TEAM!

lines.text: When your skin senses cold temperatures, these muscles yank upward!
lines.caps: When your skin senses *COLD, | these muscles yank *UPWARD | in one *SNAP!

lines.text: This pulls your arm hairs straight up like tiny radio antennas!
lines.caps: This pulls your arm hairs *STRAIGHT UP | like tiny radio *ANTENNAS!

lines.text: For furry animals like bears and cats, puffed-up fur traps pockets of warm air!
lines.caps: For furry animals, puffed-up *FUR | traps pockets of *WARM | *AIR!

lines.text: And when a cat is scared, puffed fur makes them look twice as big and scary!
lines.caps: And when an animal is *SCARED, | puffed fur makes them look twice as *BIG | and *MIGHTY!

lines.text: Humans don't have thick fur anymore, but our ancient body reflex still works!
lines.caps: Humans don't have thick *FUR, | but our ancient body reflex *STILL | *WORKS!
